Deterministically generated in Blender 5.1 by tools/blender/compartments/build_exterior.py; the whole vessel as one always-resident asset — a 28-station lofted hull 290 m by 38 m on an 8.4 m draught, boot top and sheer strake, bulbous bow, twin shafts, propellers, rudders and stabilisers, the stacked deckhouses up to the bridge at 25 m, three balcony bands, two window bands, two full-height funnels, eighteen lifeboats turned out on davits, masts, radar, ground tackle and navigation lights. It owns the shell and everything permanently outboard of or above the compartment volumes; a compartment owns what stands on its own deck, so the bands stand down over the stretches the cabin, dining and promenade compartments dress themselves. Merged by material into two named LOD groups — CM_STRUCTURE_* and CM_DRESSING_*, which is what the X1 exterior tier hides — for 20 draw meshes and 28k triangles. No external textures or third-party assets.
